title: Shout the city
prompt: Show each customer's name and their city in capital letters, as city_upper. Replace the ___.
starterSql:
SELECT name, ___(city) AS city_upper
FROM customers;

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT name, UPPER(city) AS city_upper FROM customers;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, LOWER(city) AS city_upper FROM customers;
SELECT name, city AS city_upper FROM customers;

title: Title length
prompt: Show each book's title and how many characters it has, as title_length.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM books; INSERT INTO books VALUES (10, 'Copper Moon', 'Ada Hill', 'Fantasy', 20.0, 100, 2020), (11, 'North Light', 'Raj Dev', 'Travel', 7.5, 180, 2015), (12, 'Sky Atlas', 'Ada Hill', 'Science', 25.0, 300, 2023);

solutions: SELECT title, LENGTH(title) AS title_length FROM books;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT title, LENGTH(author) AS title_length FROM books;
SELECT title, pages AS title_length FROM books;

title: First letters
prompt: Show each employee's name and the first letter of their name, as initial.
hints: SUBSTR(name, 1, 1) starts at position 1 and takes one character.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM employees; DELETE FROM departments; INSERT INTO departments VALUES (5, 'Design'), (6, 'Finance'), (7, 'Ops'); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (11, 'Ivy', 5, NULL, 90000, '2019-02-01', 900, 'ivy@acme.test'), (12, 'Jon', 5, 11, 70000, '2020-06-15', NULL, NULL), (13, 'Kim', 6, 11, 70000, '2023-03-03', 300, 'kim@acme.test'), (14, 'Leo', NULL, 77, 30000, '2024-08-20', NULL, 'leo@acme.test'), (15, 'Mia', 6, 13, 55000, '2022-12-31', 0, 'mia@acme.test');

solutions: SELECT name, SUBSTR(name, 1, 1) AS initial FROM employees;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, SUBSTR(name, 0, 1) AS initial FROM employees;
SELECT name, SUBSTR(name, 1, 2) AS initial FROM employees;

title: Tidy case
prompt: Show each contact's id and their full_name in lowercase, as clean_name.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM contacts; INSERT INTO contacts VALUES (11, 'mary jackson', 'mary-j@club.test', '555-0111', 'Hampton', 'SILVER GOLD1'), (12, 'BOB Kahn', 'bob@CLUB.test', '555-0112', NULL, 'gold1'), (13, 'Rosa Park', 'rosa@club-test', NULL, 'Tuskegee', 'NEW'), (14, 'Ken Thompson', 'ken.t@club.test', '5550114', 'Murray', 'GOLD3');

solutions: SELECT id, LOWER(full_name) AS clean_name FROM contacts;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT id, UPPER(full_name) AS clean_name FROM contacts;
SELECT id, full_name AS clean_name FROM contacts;

title: Joining with NULL
prompt: Show each contact's full_name followed by a space and their email, as label. Contacts with no email will show NULL, which is expected here.
hints: Join with ||, and put a space in quotes.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM contacts; INSERT INTO contacts VALUES (11, 'mary jackson', 'mary-j@club.test', '555-0111', 'Hampton', 'SILVER GOLD1'), (12, 'BOB Kahn', 'bob@CLUB.test', '555-0112', NULL, 'gold1'), (13, 'Rosa Park', 'rosa@club-test', NULL, 'Tuskegee', 'NEW'), (14, 'Ken Thompson', 'ken.t@club.test', '5550114', 'Murray', 'GOLD3');

solutions: SELECT full_name || ' ' || email AS label FROM contacts;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT full_name || email AS label FROM contacts;
SELECT full_name AS label FROM contacts;

title: Fix the join
prompt: This should show each customer as 'name - city' in a column named label, but it returns 0. Fix it.
starterSql:
SELECT name + ' - ' + city AS label
FROM customers;
hints: + tries to add numbers. Text joins with ||.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT name || ' - ' || city AS label FROM customers;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name || city AS label FROM customers;
SELECT name AS label FROM customers;

title: Fix the capitals
prompt: Names are messy. Show each contact's id and their full_name with only the first character capitalised and the rest lowercase, as fixed_name.
hints: Combine UPPER on the first letter with LOWER on the rest.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM contacts; INSERT INTO contacts VALUES (11, 'mary jackson', 'mary-j@club.test', '555-0111', 'Hampton', 'SILVER GOLD1'), (12, 'BOB Kahn', 'bob@CLUB.test', '555-0112', NULL, 'gold1'), (13, 'Rosa Park', 'rosa@club-test', NULL, 'Tuskegee', 'NEW'), (14, 'Ken Thompson', 'ken.t@club.test', '5550114', 'Murray', 'GOLD3');

solutions: SELECT id, UPPER(SUBSTR(full_name, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(full_name, 2)) AS fixed_name FROM contacts;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT id, UPPER(full_name) AS fixed_name FROM contacts;
SELECT id, UPPER(SUBSTR(full_name, 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(full_name, 2) AS fixed_name FROM contacts;

title: Customer codes
prompt: Make a code from the first three letters of each customer's name, in capitals, as code. Show only customers from Rome, sorted by name.
hints: Nest SUBSTR inside UPPER, and sort by name.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: UPDATE customers SET city = 'Rome' WHERE id = 5; UPDATE customers SET city = 'Lima' WHERE id = 2;

solutions: SELECT UPPER(SUBSTR(name, 1, 3)) AS code FROM customers WHERE city = 'Rome' ORDER BY name;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT UPPER(SUBSTR(name, 1, 3)) AS code FROM customers ORDER BY name;
SELECT SUBSTR(name, 1, 3) AS code FROM customers WHERE city = 'Rome' ORDER BY name;
